products.product_description: Lemon, Sage Parmesan & Romano Cream Sauce. The product is in a 12.6 oz. Mason glass jar, lid and ring, and tamper evident shrink wrapped. UPC 8 60001 31924 8. The label is read in parts: "*** LEMON SAGE PARMESAN & ROMANO CREAM SAUCE *** Ingredients: Heavy whipping cream, white wine, butter, shallot, garlic, fresh parsley & sage, lemon juice, chili flakes, lemon zest, salt & pepper *** Made with Real Cheese***Keep Refrigerated ******Kumpunny's Gourmet Sauces & Marinades***Grants Pass, OR***".
products.reason_for_recall: Label declares heavy cream and butter but it does not list milk.
